sourceOfPaths: NSBundle.mainBundle only; argc must equal 1; no path or executable from environment or arguments
nativeScope: Exact INSTALLER manifest raw-byte hash and strict shape
Fixed Node, controller, entry helper and core helper hashes and executable role modes
Exact declared runtime file closure; no unlisted files or test entries
Payload directory identity, receipt raw hash, receipt metadata, PROGRAM and BOOTSTRAP raw hashes
No symlinks or regular-file hardlinks; owner must be effective uid or root; no group/world writable components
Native held-fd reads with before/after stat, F_GETPATH and reopen identity checks
payloadFullInventory: Deferred to fixed hash-bound trusted Node bundle configuration and controller preview; native layer does not claim this check
success: Returns internally verified fixed-role paths and hashes; no child process started and no open descriptor transferred
revalidation: This receipt is admission evidence, not a lasting filesystem capability; trusted Node must revalidate its manifest, closure and full payload before preview/install
testOnly: SEP_INSTALLER_ADMISSION_REPORT exposes verified config to synthetic tests
SEP_INSTALLER_ADMISSION_TEST_HOOK exposes one fixed held-fd read boundary through owned fd 3; omitted from production
nonTestProbe: Always refuses SEP_INSTALLER_UI_NOT_CONNECTED even after successful admission; it is not an installer UI
isolationLimit: Ad-hoc signing and same-user re-signing are not an isolation boundary; arbitrary same-user code is outside this guarantee
